text:
alana (product): Quick planning pulse for the Q3 routing cutover. Need a short, actionable playbook: concrete gate metrics, per-step owners, and an explicit rollback ladder so oncall and CS know when to stop the rollout.

matt (eng): I can draft. Proposal: per-region ramp percentages: 0.5% -> 5% -> 20% -> 100%. Canary windows: 30m for the tiny slice, 2h for broader ramps. Abort on hard SLOs.

jordan (sre): Let's be explicit about SLO thresholds. My suggestion: sustained 5xx > 0.5% for 5m OR p95 latency increase >25% vs baseline (and absolute p95 > 1.2s) => automated pause + pager.

tara (cs): Customer safety: if any of top-10 tenants see >2x latency or repeated errors, we hold and notify CS lead. Need a per-tenant opt-out switch for VIPs.

matt (eng): We can route VIP tenants to the previous path by default for the first two ramps. Also adding a fallback model variant (model-v1-fallback) that’s cheaper/smaller to reduce error exposure without full revert.

jordan (sre): Recommend a 3-level rollback ladder encoded in automation: 1) throttle problematic slice to 10% and switch to fallback-variant, 2) after 15m if errors persist revert slice to previous stable model (model-v1), 3) if still failing perform feature-flag kill + global rollback.

matt (eng): Will add to flag playbook. Drafted rollout config for Console:```yaml
flag: routing_cutover_2024_q3
steps:
  - pct: 0.5
    duration: 30m
    checks: ["5xx < 0.5%", "p95_delta < 25%"]
  - pct: 5
    duration: 2h
  - pct: 20
    duration: 2h
  - pct: 100
    duration: 1h
fallback_variant: model-v1-fallback
vip_holdback: true
auto_rollback: false
rollback_ladder: [throttle_and_fallback, revert_model_slice, kill_flag_global]
```

alana (product): Good. Add owner fields per step: engineer_oncall, product_lead, cs_rep. Specify SLAs for response: if a step triggers, SRE action within 5m, CS contact within 10m.

jordan (sre): I'll wire up runbook hooks to post automated Slack pings and escalate if not acknowledged. Example alert text: `ALERT: routing_cutover_2024_q3  region=eu-west  symptom=p95_spike(2.1s)  action=throttle_to_10%_and_switch_fallback`. Reaction expectations: :eyes: ack from oncall, :white_check_mark: once mitigated.

tara (cs): Also need a customer comms snippet and a list of VIP tenants for the opt-out. CS wants the opt-out to be a single toggle we can flip via Console.

matt (eng): Per-tenant flagging exists; I'll expose a "VIP_holdback" toggle in the rollout UI and default it on for the first two ramps.

jordan (sre): Metrics beyond infra to evaluate the rollout: quality evals (core prompt set delta, e.g., QA accuracy or BLEU-type proxy), support ticket rate (tickets/hour), and CS manual thumbs. Pass criteria after 24h at 100%: quality delta < 2% on core evals, overall 5xx increase < 0.3%, and <=3 P0/P1 customer incidents.

alana (product): OK next actions: Matt -> upload playbook + Console rollout config; Jordan -> update runbook automation and alert copy; Tara -> prepare VIP list + customer note. I'll schedule a 15-minute dry-run with oncall & CS before go.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled  routing_cutover_2024_q3 staged rollout start=2024-07-18T16:00Z (canary slice).

matt (eng): One question: do we default to automated rollback or pause-and-wait? I prefer pause + scripted rollback to avoid accidental global kill.

jordan (sre): Agreed. Default auto_rollback=false. Runbook will include an opt-in for auto_rollback for trusted experiments.

tara (cs): I'll send VIP list to matt by EOD and draft a short customer-facing note. :shipit: 

alana (product): Nice work. This gives us a clear, owner-assigned ladder and decision criteria. We'll iterate after the dry-run.
